title: La Palacio Andaluz Flamenco Show
text: Once in Seville, we realized there were many flamenco shows in Old Town and areas close to it. We are so glad we kept our reservations at La Palacio Andaluz! A long walk or short Uber ride from Old Town, it was well worth the time. The performances were magnificent and the music was great. We ordered the dinner and it was delicious and the portions were over the top. I highly recommend this particular show if you want to see high quality flamenco!
author: dorothyk734

title: Beautiful performance and seamless experience
text:
This was a highlight of our time in Seville. The entire experience was very well organized from start to finish, which made it easy to relax and enjoy the evening. The theater itself was beautiful and intimate, creating the perfect atmosphere for a flamenco performance.

The dancers were incredibly talented — powerful, expressive, and completely captivating. You could really feel the emotion and artistry in every movement. Highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Seville.

title: I'm not a great dancer, but I highly recommend it.
text: Excellent flamenco show at the Andalusian Palace. We went in group, we arrived already the show had begun. The places were great and with good visibility from the stage. The ticket included a drink during the dance presentation. Also count on a photographer who will record your presence and try to sell you the photo. The team of dancers is fantastic and gifts the audience present, with a truly interesting choreography at the level of dance and singing of the traditional Flamenco. It is a spectacle not to be missed in Seville.
